_catatan: Naskah explainer gdl-logistics (disetujui Farrez 19 Nov 2026). Babak 4 menyebut email saja karena nomor WhatsApp di main.js GDL masih kosong.

gaya.id: Bacakan sebagai narator film dokumenter yang tenang, hangat, dan yakin, seperti video explainer sejarah. Tempo sedang, beri jeda panjang di antara paragraf.
gaya.en: Read as a calm, warm, confident documentary narrator, like a history explainer video. Medium pace, with a long pause between paragraphs.

teks.id: Barang beku dan dingin harus tetap dingin dari gudang sampai ke pelanggan. Usaha butuh truk pendingin yang bisa dipesan saat perlu.
teks.en: Frozen and chilled goods have to stay cold from the warehouse to the customer. A business needs a refrigerated truck it can book when it needs one.

teks.id: Tidak semua usaha butuh truk setiap hari. Truk bisa dipesan saat perlu, dengan harga yang disepakati per trip.
teks.en: Not every business needs a truck every day. A truck can be booked when needed, at a price agreed per trip.

judul.en: THE BOX THAT BECOMES A TRUCK

teks.id: Di halamannya, kardus yang digulir pelan-pelan berubah jadi truk pendingin. Pengunjung langsung paham apa yang dijual.
teks.en: On the page, a box you scroll slowly turns into a refrigerated truck. Visitors get what is on offer right away.

teks.id: Permintaan penawaran langsung tersusun, tinggal kirim lewat email.
teks.en: A quote request writes itself, ready to send by email.
